title: personal-kpi-weekly-checkin-nora-wells-2026-05-02
content:
Weekly check-in (notes to self) - 2026-05-02

Quick context:
- Working on inference autoscaling MVP for Dedicated pools (Q2 deliverable). Primary goal: reduce tail latency p95 for 512-token requests while keeping cost within 8% of baseline.
- Main metrics I track this sprint: p95 latency (ms), median latency (ms), cost per 1k tokens, successful autoscale decisions (%), incidents triggered by scaling.

This week — wins:
- Experiment 7 (async KV prefetch + smaller micro-batches) reduced p95 from ~340ms -> ~285ms on a 2-node Dedicated pool for our 512 token synthetic workload. Median improved 20ms.
  - Note: variance still high when request mix includes many short chat messages (seq len < 64).
- Hooked up cost-tracking tag to the experiment runs; can now attribute token cost differences to batching policy changes in the dashboard.
- Deployed canary for autoscale policy v2 to 10% traffic on staging; no regressions observed over 48h.

Open blockers / risks:
- One flakey test in release pipeline: integration-tests/autoscale/e2e times out intermittently (~1/10 runs). Suspect it's related to test harness not mocking instance startup time accurately. Filed LINEAR-PLT-1289 to track.
- Need performance comparison on nv12 vs nv16 GPU types — infra not yet provisioned for nv16 in sandbox. Follow up with Devin to request quota (Devin assigned).
- Some customer-facing metrics (console per-route p95) show higher variance than our internal benchmarking — likely due to heterogeneous early traffic (mix of embedding requests + chat). Need to add route-level workload classifier to attribution pipeline.

Personal KPI status (tracking against Q2 goals):
- KPI 1: Reduce p95 512-token latency for Dedicated pools by 15% vs baseline.
  - Baseline (2026-04-01): 335ms p95.
  - Current rolling p95 (2026-05-02): 285ms p95 (15% achieved). Progress: on track, but still tight margin when accounting for mixed workloads.
- KPI 2: Keep cost delta <= 8% vs baseline after autoscale and batching changes.
  - Baseline cost per 1k tokens: $0.95
  - Current measured: $1.02 (~7.4% increase). Close to threshold — need to optimize further before ramping to 50% traffic.
- KPI 3: <1% incidents induced by scaling policy in production after rollout.
  - Current: 0 incidents in staging canary; need more traffic and chaos testing.

Plans for next week:
- Stabilize e2e test: reproduce flake locally with test harness changes (mock startup latencies). Aim to close LINEAR-PLT-1289 by EOD Wed.
- Run full nv16 vs nv12 perf sweep (with Devin) — collect p50/p95/cost. Blocker: infra quota.
- Implement quick route-level workload classifier to better attribute console p95 variance; prototype to send labels into the metrics pipeline (P0 for visibility).
- Start a small canary (20%) in staging for another 72h capturing real customer-like mix (include embeddings). Ensure cost tags and rollout metrics are collected.

Personal retrospective / notes to self:
- Communication: I should sync earlier with CS/console team about metric interpretation — they saw spike and pinged me before I had the attribution data ready. Quick FYI pings would help.
- Timeboxing: spent more time than planned debugging the batcher test; need to block 1 afternoon for deep-dive and not let it spill into planned sprint tasks.
- Documentation: write a short doc about the new tagging and cost-attribution method so Console and Finance can read the assumptions. Add to my TODO.

TODO (short):
- [ ] Reproduce e2e flake locally and update tests (LINEAR-PLT-1289) — due Wed
- [ ] Request nv16 sandbox quota with Devin — due Mon
- [ ] Prototype route-level classifier and push metrics labels — due Fri
- [ ] Draft 1-pager for Console/Finance about cost-tagging changes — due next Tue

Questions / decisions needed from manager:
- Can we allocate $X to nv16 quota for the sandbox (short burst)? Depends on budget — ask Mark.
- OK to move canary to 20% next week if nv16 results look good? (I'll prepare rollback plan.)

Misc notes / links:
- PRs: GH PR #4821 (autoscale-policy-v2), GH PR #4809 (batcher prefetch prototype)
- Confluence draft: CONFLUENCE-PLT-ops-kpis (working doc)
- Linear: LINEAR-PLT-1289 (e2e flake)

End of check-in. Keep this doc as my working scratchpad for next check-in.

— Nora
